fun_facts: Dak Prescott grew up in Haughton, Louisiana, and played football wherever he could—even on streets and in parking lots.
As a kid, Dak Prescott played tackle football without pads against his older, much bigger brothers and their friends.
Dak Prescott led Mississippi State to its first No. 1 ranking in 2014.
Dak Prescott left Mississippi State with 38 school records.
Rayne Dakota Prescott is his full name, and his family has called him Dak since birth.

From Quintorris Lopez Jones to Elisha Nelson Manning, check out the real names of your favorite NFL stars.

Dak Prescott: **Rayne Dakota Prescott**

Kids can be cruel, classmates used to ridicule [Dak Prescott](https://www.nfl.com/player/dakprescott/2555260/profile) for his given name. "When I started off school, they would always call me Rayne [RAINY], or Rayne [RYE-KNEE], or something," said Prescott on The Fan's Shan and RJ Show. "They'd be like, 'This is a girl's name,' so I just always went by Dakota, but I was given Dak by birth, so my family's always called me Dak."

Nearly two decades later, Rayne is a [Pro Bowl](http://www.nfl.com/probowl) quarterback leading America's Team.
